title: Prelude in C major · BWV 846
typesetter: Shay Rojansky, Han-Wen Nienhuys and Tobias Erbsland
description: The complete 35-bar prelude from The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book I. Two hands; the repeating arpeggios retain the bass and inner-voice holds.
warnings: Fermatas are not held longer in the practice timeline; pause as long as you like. See bar 35.
The original final chord is arpeggiated (rolled); this practice timeline plays its notes together. The original PDF shows the performance marking.

verification.explanation: MIDI can merge or truncate simultaneous same-key voices; written LilyPond duration is authoritative. MusicXML/App timing compares exactly after standard same-onset physical-key coalescing. Third-note MIDI gates may differ by one MIDI tick.
